entry: npm run selftest (selftest/run.ts) — runs exactly this manifest; exit non-zero on any failure, any unreported id, any unlisted id, or any skip without a reviewed justification accepted by the caller

runners.db: selftest/db/fable01.sql — psql against $SUPABASE_DB_URL (CI local stack); the same file runs on the management channel; one row per id
runners.static: selftest/static.test.ts — repository and production build; no database, no network
runners.app: selftest/app.test.ts — black-box HTTP against the production-mode app and the Supabase project's Auth/Storage surface with real persona JWTs

facilities.app: always (the runner builds and starts the app itself)
facilities.ci: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true; upstream job results in SELFTEST_CI_UPSTREAM
